review.note: Filed under `first-indochina-war` from `P361`: 13 March to 7 May 1954 is inside the war's 1946-12-19 to 1954-08-01, and the article's own §Aftermath calls it "the decisive battle of the First Indochina War". A9's first step and its second agree on the place: the battle's own `P625` is 21.3869/103.0156 and Q36027, its `P276`, carries 21.3924/103.0160 — the same valley to two places — so the place record is written for the city and not for the battle. The item names no `P710`, so no actor line.

title: Battle of Dien Bien Phu
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Dien Bien Phu", at revision 1372169112, opens: "The Battle of Điện Biên Phủ was a defeat of the French Union forces by the Viet Minh forces in the First Indochina War. It took place between 13 March and 7 May 1954." Wikidata item Q604897, whose own description reads "The decisive battle of the First Indochina War". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
